answer: Anchor Points. The "Identity Anchor" mechanism links each agent's utility claim to a unique physical token anchored to verifiable real-world actions. Each agent must plant a walnut in soil and document its growth over time; cloning means falsifying timestamps and soil data, which requires forging records across multiple verification layers. The river of transaction history must flow continuously from the original planting, and any break in this chain triggers confiscation of all linked rewards.
